title: 礼来新一代减肥药再闯关，申请FDA审批时间表出炉
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We had an important update from Lily today about when it plans to file for regulatory approval for its next-generation weight loss shot, Reddit True Tide, which is going to be a pretty big product for Lily if it ends up being approved already.
segments.zh: 今天礼来公布了重要进展，计划为其下一代减肥药Retatrutide申请监管批准。如果获批，这将是礼来的一款重磅产品。

segments.en: There are a lot of people seeking out black market versions of this drug just because they've heard about all of the potentially incredible effects, everything from up to 30% weight loss to liver impacts.
segments.zh: 很多人寻求黑市版本的这种药物，因为他们听说了其潜在惊人效果，包括减重高达30%以及对肝脏的影响。

segments.en: All of these other potential health benefits like anti-inflammation and all of these things.
segments.zh: 还有其他潜在健康益处，比如抗炎等。

segments.en: Lily said that they are going to apply for FDA approval sometime in the first quarter of 2027, which is a little bit later than some analysts had expected.
segments.zh: 礼来表示将在2027年第一季度申请FDA批准，这比一些分析师预期的稍晚。

segments.en: But that's just because the data package and the filing that they have to put together is so big.
segments.zh: 这是因为需要准备的数据包和申报材料非常庞大。

segments.en: So, how will this be materially different or better than what's on the market right now?
segments.zh: 那么，这款新药与现有药物相比，有何实质性不同或优势？

segments.en: Because people are getting really substantial weight loss and it seems to be working already. What's this new and getting to do?
segments.zh: 因为现有药物已经能带来显著减重效果，这款新药又能做什么？

segments.en: Yeah, that's exactly right. I mean, Zepbound, which is Lily's other weight loss shot in Wagovie, which is a no-vernorative product, are really good.
segments.zh: 没错。礼来的另一款减肥药Zepbound和诺和诺德的Wagovie效果都很好。

segments.en: Like you said, people are getting a lot of success with those now. Reddit True Tide, which that's the sort of generic chemical name.
segments.zh: 如你所说，很多人使用这些药物取得了成功。Retatrutide是通用化学名。

segments.en: It doesn't have a brand name yet, because it's not approved.
segments.zh: 它还没有品牌名，因为尚未获批。

segments.en: Combines three different gut hormone, so it's GLP1, which we've all heard so much about.
segments.zh: 它结合了三种不同的肠道激素，包括我们熟知的GLP1。

segments.en: Plus another one called glucagon and another called GIP. Basically, it just supercharges the drug a little bit.
segments.zh: 再加上胰高血糖素和GIP，相当于给药物加了点动力。
